cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

mechanism: Copy cancellation colors across a bookings spreadsheet, then claim the concrete benefit of the resulting alarm without admitting the misunderstanding.
confusable: Not knowingly flagging every booking: B2 must reveal red means cancelled and A3 must pretend comprehensive checking.
comparison: Administrative error produces useful discovery, unlike physical inspection contribution in a.
seedUse: Retains spreadsheet/bookings/contribution request; authors a false-cancellation alert uncovering three rooms, not the seed's thirty.
